# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
Copy the inspection records into the spreadsheet.
3. Add in the inspection id.
4. Add in the decision, and if the decision is a fail, add in the decision reason.
5. Add in the timestamp.
  This should be the date of the inspection (if the inspecting was before 12/31/2015) or the date of the city's first notice that a permit was required (if the inspection was after 12/31/2015).
  Inspectors are not required to document the range of dates they inspected when they submit a fail, so we don't want to assume that they inspected only the dates that they document on the inspection record.
